heroTitle: Mandala – where body and mind find balance
heroAlt: Mandala lobby with cream sofas, bamboo lamps and pampas grass
meaning: In Sanskrit, mandala means “circle” – a symbol of wholeness, harmony and the universe within each of us. Like petals arranged around a centre, true wellbeing comes only when body, mind and emotions are nurtured together.
We chose this name as a promise: every treatment at Mandala is not only about easing an hour of tiredness, but about helping you find calm, relax deeply and restore your wellbeing at its roots.
meaningAlt: Wellness corner with lacquer art, bamboo lamps and lotus flowers
story: Mandala was born from a wish to bring traditional Eastern wellness closer to the people of Buon Ma Thuot and its visitors – a place where you can care for your health gently and regularly, at a fair price.

pillars.title: Calm
pillars.text: A quiet space, soft light and the scent of herbs help your mind settle.

pillars.title: Relax
pillars.text: Caring hands release the tension your body has been holding.

pillars.title: Restore
pillars.text: Wellness therapies help your body rebalance and stay healthy in the long run.

teamText: Our therapists are professionally trained in therapeutic massage and traditional wellness. They always listen first and care for every guest with genuine dedication.
teamAlt: Mandala therapist giving a therapeutic massage
commitments: Fresh towels and linen for every guest
